content.text: Where are my techy buddies? What’s a good laptop for a high-school grad / incoming college freshman? I need something that’s gonna last all 4 years lolI made 2,583 sales in 2025 which is average 7 sales a day…I made 10 sales in 2022.No crazy lesson or insight here… I just show up everyday & damn I’ve really done it. WOW 🥹❤️‍🔥Telecasters just make sense #telecaster #guitarsolo #guitarplayersAll these races need to stop being on Sunday!!! I have church 😭😭Nice start by OKC tonight. Feels good seeing all the roster together finally!This book got me yelling at imaginary characters.. 😒 Your success will make the people around you uncomfortable. #jeezy 🎥 Wizards are starting Juju Reese tonight.Today has been one of my most productive and fun working days, chatting with engineers about Instagram’s codebase (and what to do about it) and also about an upcoming hike in PNW (yay!), learning from a YT engineer about what they are doing with AI4P (comfirmed that they only used Gemini, not 3P models or interfaces), …But then I don’t have any time vibe coding or adding another agent or skills.
